messages:
maria: Quick sync 1 proposing 'quiesce quorum' rollout + auto fallback scoring for model & flag switches. Need clear canary/A-B gates + ops playbook.

tyler: +1. Metrics: p95 latency delta <20% AND error-rate delta <0.1% vs cohort baseline.

eva: Add 120s quiesce after flip per cohort to avoid warmup noise.

jamal: Factor customer-impact so big tenants surface earlier and can be opted-out.

eva: Config sketch: {quiesce_seconds:120, ramps:[0.5,5,20,100], eval_metrics:[p95_latency,error_rate,hallucination_rate], min_samples:200, auto_pause:40, auto_rollback:70}

tyler: Treat A/B arms as independent cohorts with their own baselines and min-sample gates.

maria: Scoring: normalize metric deltas -> weighted sum (latency 30, errors 40, halluc 20, cust 10). If customer-impact>0.8, multiply score by 1.5.

eva: Gate: do not score until cohort >=200 requests. Ramp windows: 30m per step.

tyler: If cohort score>40 -> pause and notify #oncall; if >=70 -> immediate rollback + page.

maria: Ops playbook (short): mark cohort 'quiescing' 120s, evaluate 1m rolling windows, collect traces on pause, allow tenant_opt_out & bypass_quiesce roles, audit every flip.

ops-bot: deploy queued 2025-01-15T22:00Z 1 runbook linked.

maria: I'll draft the spec + pseudocode and open PR for Console/CLI controls. Ping for review. :thumbsup:
